symptom: `declare $X Integer = 'abc';`, `set $X = 'abc';` and `return $Decimal` from a microflow that returns String all passed `mxcli check -p` and `exec`, then MxBuild reported CE0117 "Error(s) in expression" (Mendix CLI 2: CE0844 "The expression is of type String but should be of type Integer/Long").
file: mdl/exprcheck/target_kind.go checkTargetKind; Context.Target in mdl/exprcheck/interfaces.go; mdl/exprcheck/adapters/check.go checkExprAs / primitiveTarget / setTargetKind. Tests: mdl/exprcheck/target_kind_test.go TestTargetKindMatrix, mdl/exprcheck/adapters/target_kind_test.go
cause: The slot table declared DeclareStmt.InitialValue (DeclareType), MfSetStmt.Value (TargetVariable) and ReturnStmt.Value (MicroflowReturn) with a ResolveBy, and checkSlotKind skips every slot with a ResolveBy, so nothing compared the value with the declared type. Same gap #2096 closed for a call argument.
insight: **A ResolveBy entry in the slot table that nothing resolves is a rule that looks present and checks nothing; grep the ResolveBy values against what the adapter actually qualifies.** Measured before writing the rule: 216 microflows (3 positions x 6 primitive types x 12 value shapes) in one project, one `mx check -j` on 11.16.1, results keyed by the JSON document-name so one run answers the whole matrix. All three positions behave identically, every rejection is CE0117, and the accepted set equals callArgAccepted, so the predicate is reused and the matrix is the test. `empty` into a Boolean is also CE0117 and is deliberately left silent, as for a call argument. Overlap: MDL041 already reports a COMPUTED Decimal into Integer/Long by DECLARE/SET, so those are skipped here (a bare Decimal literal or variable, and any RETURN, are not MDL041's). False-positive sweep: a throwaway test parsed every .mdl in the repo and ran the adapter with no project, 1649 flows in 1267 scripts, 0 hits after the MDL041 skip (1 before: the intentional negative test bug-tests/f2-decimal-func-into-integer.fail.mdl). `check -p` is blind to this on a script that also has an unresolved reference, so a sweep through the CLI against a stand-in project reports zero for the wrong reason; run the adapter directly. Control: stubbing checkTargetKind to return nil fails TestTargetKindMatrix, the wiring test and the nanoflow test.
